description: ABC Analysis is an approach for classifying items based on their classification value. The value is the total value of an item calculated over a specified time period. This approach is based off the Pareto Principal i.e. the 80/20 rule which states for many events, 80% of the effects come from 20% of the causes. The ABC Indicator denotes which items are classified as: A - Signficant Material, B - Medium Significance Material, C - Low Significance Material, D - Least Significance, E- Zero Significance or O - Obsolete.
exampleValues: A, B, C, D, E, or O
